measure.name: ground_characteristics
measure.description: Improves the calculation of the heat exchanged between the building and the ground. By default, EnergyPlus assumes a constant 18 °C under the building all year round. This measure lets you choose between your own monthly temperatures, the F/C-factor method (with the weather-file temperatures at 0.5 m or your own) and Kiva (2D ground calculation with perimeter insulation), without editing the IDF.
measure.modeler_description: Acts on the BuildingSurface:Detailed objects with a ground boundary condition (Ground, GroundFCfactorMethod, Foundation or preprocessors). Exposed perimeter of each slab: sum of its edges that do not coincide with edges of another ground-contact slab (absolute coordinates). GROUND: Ground boundary condition + Site:GroundTemperature:BuildingSurface. F/C-FACTOR: one Construction:FfactorGroundFloor per slab (area and exposed perimeter from the geometry; slabs without exposed perimeter become Adiabatic) and one Construction:CfactorUndergroundWall per below-grade wall (height = vertical extent; C given or 1/ΣR of its construction); GroundFCfactorMethod boundary condition; weather-file temperatures at 0.5 m (Site:GroundTemperature:FCfactorMethod is removed) or manual ones. KIVA: one Foundation:Kiva (optional perimeter insulation and concrete foundation wall), Foundation:Kiva:Settings and SurfaceProperty:ExposedFoundationPerimeter (computed TotalExposedPerimeter); below-grade walls of zones with a Kiva slab also become Foundation; Material:NoMass or AirGap layers are replaced by an equivalent massive layer with the same resistance. Surfaces with an internal source (ConstructionProperty:InternalHeatSource) cannot use F/C-factor or Kiva and are kept as Ground. The vertices of F/C and Kiva walls are rotated to start at the upper-left corner (this is how EnergyPlus computes their height). Shallow/Deep are used only by ground heat exchangers.

argument.name: method
argument.description: Only the arguments of the selected method are used (the rest are ignored).

choice.display_name: Ground: monthly temperatures under the building (BuildingSurface)
F/C-factor: F-factor slabs and C-factor walls (FCfactorMethod)

argument.name: ground_temperatures
argument.description: 12 values (Jan...Dec) separated by commas, with a decimal point; or separated by ';' if a decimal comma is used. EnergyPlus guidance: about 2 °C below the average indoor temperature (typical US commercial buildings). Do not use the weather-file (undisturbed ground) values: they are too extreme under a conditioned building. With F/C-factor or Kiva, they are used for the surfaces those methods cannot handle (with a warning).

argument.name: fc_source
argument.description: EPW: EnergyPlus takes those of the weather-file header at 0.5 m (the object is not written).

choice.display_name: From the weather file (EPW) at 0.5 m depth

argument.name: fc_temperatures
argument.description: Only when the source is 'Manual'. 12 values (Jan...Dec) separated by commas, with a decimal point; or separated by ';' if a decimal comma is used. They should be similar to the monthly mean outdoor air temperature delayed by about 3 months.

argument.name: fc_f_factor
argument.description: Heat loss per metre of exposed perimeter and per degree. Uninsulated slab (ASHRAE 90.1, F-0.73 Btu/h·ft·°F): 1.264 W/m·K. From a slab U-value that already includes the ground (e.g. the Spanish CTE Us): F = U · A/P (the measure reports A/P for each slab).

argument.name: fc_c_factor
argument.display_name: [F/C-factor] Below-grade wall C-factor [W/m²·K] (0 = from its construction)
argument.description: Wall transmittance without air films or soil. 0: computed for each wall from its current construction, C = 1/Σ(e/λ). Reference: uninsulated 8-in concrete block wall (ASHRAE 90.1, C-1.140 Btu/h·ft²·°F) = 6.473 W/m²·K.

argument.name: kiva_deep_ground_boundary
argument.description: Autoselect: water table if known; otherwise zero flux.

argument.name: kiva_insulation_conductivity
argument.description: For all insulation positions (density 35 kg/m³ and specific heat 1400 J/kg·K).

argument.name: kiva_interior_horizontal_insulation
argument.description: Under the slab, from the wall inwards. Thickness 0 = no insulation in this position.

argument.name: kiva_interior_vertical_insulation
argument.description: Inside the foundation wall, from its top downwards.

argument.name: kiva_exterior_horizontal_insulation
argument.display_name: [Kiva] Exterior horizontal insulation: thickness [m], width [m], depth [m]
argument.description: Buried outside the building; width from the wall outwards; depth below grade.

argument.name: kiva_exterior_vertical_insulation
argument.description: Outside the foundation wall, from its top downwards.

argument.name: kiva_foundation_wall
argument.display_name: [Kiva] Foundation wall: height above grade [m], depth below slab [m], thickness [m]
argument.description: Top of the wall above the outside grade, and extension of the wall below the slab (EnergyPlus defaults: 0.2 and 0). Concrete wall (1.95 W/m·K, 2240 kg/m³, 900 J/kg·K); used for slabs without below-grade walls in their zone.

argument.name: write_shallow_deep
argument.description: Used ONLY by some ground heat exchangers. They do not affect floors or walls.

argument.name: shallow_temperatures
argument.description: 12 values (Jan...Dec) separated by commas, with a decimal point; or separated by ';' if a decimal comma is used.

argument.name: deep_temperatures
argument.description: 12 values (Jan...Dec) separated by commas, with a decimal point; or separated by ';' if a decimal comma is used.
